infobox.usage: Unlocks dorm room 103 in the three story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Dorm room 103 key (Dorm 103) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the three-story dormitory with a tag reading "103" on it.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The first floor of the three-story dorms on Customs.
